name: Emmanuel Durosinmi
story: My journey of personal growth began while I was in SS1. From a young age, I developed a deep passion for technology. I spent countless hours learning graphics design, programming, ethical hacking, and other digital skills. Alongside a few classmates, I challenged myself every day to learn something new. That healthy competition helped me build valuable skills and a mindset of continuous learning. Today, I am not someone who has built not only a business but also a better version of myself. I have developed strong leadership, communication, public speaking, and networking skills, built meaningful relationships with people from different backgrounds, and gained the confidence to lead and inspire others. My journey has taught me that success is not defined by where you start, but by your willingness to learn, grow, and never give up.
